name: Summer Days
source:
Briana has been craving some time off all summer and finally with her shoot wrapped for hiatus she can relax at her summer cottage on the lake.
To really enjoy herself she even drags her female co-stars along for the ride.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
布丽安娜整个夏天都盼着休假。如今，她的拍摄工作终于告一段落，进入休拍期，她也可以在湖畔的夏日小屋放松了。
为了尽情享受假期，她甚至拉上了几位合作的女演员一同前往。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160620/]Steam[/url]]
